title: AX-200 Industrial Temperature Sensor
key_sentences: The AX-200 is a digital temperature sensor with an I2C interface and a 12-bit resolution.
It operates from 2.7 V to 5.5 V and draws less than 250 µA in active mode.
An open-drain alert output signals when the temperature crosses a programmable limit.
Unless otherwise noted, limits apply at VDD = 3.3 V and an ambient temperature of 25 °C.
The temperature register is read with a two-byte transfer.
The following sketch assumes the default address of 0x48.

list_items.text: 1. All voltages are referenced to GND.
2. Accuracy excludes self-heating, which is below 0.1 °C in still air.
3. Do not exceed the absolute maximum ratings:
- voltage on any pin -0.3 V to VDD + 0.3 V.

notes: Producer ReportLab 5.0.1 Platypus. Helvetica, Helvetica-Bold and Courier, standard-14, NOT embedded. A blue banner is drawn on every page with the company name and revision line (furniture, not headings). Bullets are typed U+2022; Notes use '1.' '2.' '3.' with a nested hyphen level. Electrical characteristics is a full-grid table with zebra rows; the dash cells are en dashes meaning 'not specified'. The pin table has a header rule only. The Ordering table has two-line cells joined by a space. The code block is monospaced Courier; the program text contains '<<' characters.
